mentions.name: VT Code
mentions.description: A coding harness the author builds and improves as a hobby, planning continued development throughout the month. It recently gained a native macOS desktop app built using GPUI.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the past few weeks, I have spent my hobby as building and improving my own coding harness, VT Code. I plan to keep improving it throughout this month. Recently, I built a native macOS using GPUI (gpui.rs).
mentions.author: vinhnx
